title: Research Assistant - Molecular Biology & RNA Lab
description: Requirements: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Molecular Biology. Hands-on laboratory experience with qPCR, Western blotting, RNA/DNA isolation, and mammalian cell culture. Fluent English required. German is a plus.

title: Junior Computational Chemist - Molecular Docking
description: Requirements: Degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or Pharmacy. Experience with AutoDock Vina, structure-based drug design, PDB databases, and Python scripting.

title: Bioinformatics Scientist - Cancer Genomics
description: Requirements: M.Sc. in Bioinformatics. Experience analyzing TCGA data, differential expression, survival analysis in R and Python. Knowledge of cancer biology.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow - Structural Biology & Cryo-EM
description: Requirements: Ph.D. in Structural Biology, Biophysics, or Biochemistry. Proven track record with Cryo-EM data collection and processing.

title: Senior Clinical Project Manager - Oncology
description: Requirements: 8+ years of clinical trial management experience. MD or Ph.D. preferred. Fluent German and English.

title: Working Student - Lab Automation & Assay Development
description: Requirements: Enrolled student in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or related field. Basic PCR knowledge, willingness to learn automated liquid handling.
